item.title: Kingdom win League opener
item.description: Kerry’s Allianz Football League title defence has started with a win over Roscommon. At Fitzgerald Stadium the Kingdom were victorious by 2-18 to 1-20 thanks to a last second score Advertisement Twice in the opening minutes Kerry went a point in front but on each occasion Roscommon equalised. item.title: Allianz Hurling League review
item.description: The Cork hurlers have impressed under new boss Ben O'Connor this afternoon. They smashed Waterford 3-25 to 1-17 in their first game of the National Hurling League Division 1A. Declan Dalton, William Buckley and Alan Connolly with the Rebel goals. Advertisement Kilkenny opened their campaign with a win. The Cats beat Offaly by 20 points to 16 at Nowlan Park. Clare came from behind to beat Dublin by 3-18 to 1-22 in Division 1B.

item.title: Chelsea win at Palace
item.description: Chelsea are into the Premier League's top four after beating Crystal Palace this afternoon. The Blues eased to a 3-1 win over their London rivals thanks to goals from Estevao, Joao Pedro and Enzo Fernandez. The Eagles went down to 10 men after Adam Wharton picked up two yellow cards. Advertisement Aston Villa have kept pace with second-placed Manchester City with a 2-nil win at Newcastle. item.description: Cork 1-10 Kildare 2-7 By Ger McCarthy Cork and Kildare played out a thrilling Lidl National Football League Division 1 draw at MTU Cork. item.title: MTU Kerry academics deliver lectures on foreign language education in Romania
item.description: Two MTU Kerry academics travelled to Romania recently to lecture on foreign language education and intercultural communication. The Interconnected Learning and Teaching Conference (ILT 2025) attracted academics and practitioners from across Europe. Professor Muiris Ó Laoire delivered the conference keynote address on the importance of real-life skills like communicating with people from different cultural backgrounds, and speaking foreign languages. item.title: Councillor calls for comprehensive update on Tralee Flood Relief Scheme
item.description: There are calls for councillors to be provided with a comprehensive update on the progress and plans for the Tralee Flood Relief Scheme. Fianna Fáil councillor Anne O’Sullivan tabled a motion on the project at the recent Tralee Municipal District meeting. She told the meeting certain projects were being delayed due to the flood review scheme and she felt there was a huge time-lag regarding this project. item.title: Ireland call up uncapped prop
item.description: Andy Farrell has called up uncapped prop Billy Bohan to his Ireland pre-Six Nations training squad. The Connacht man comes in for the injured Jack Boyle who was stretchered off in Leinster's win over the Westerners yesterday. Munster's Tom Ahern will also be replaced by Cormac Izuchukwu of Ulster, while Robert Baloucoune will continue to be assessed over the coming days.
